messages.subject: Error after Deployment
parts:
After making a few changes to my app, I republished it.  However, the deployed version will not run. The message I get looks like this.

Error

/opt/redx/lua/src/lib/plugins/authorization.lua:35: attempt to concatenate field 'shinyapps' (a nil value)

Traceback

stack traceback:
	/opt/redx/lua/src/lib/plugins/authorization.lua:35: in function 'post'
	/opt/redx/lua/src/bin/main.lua:67: in function 'process_request'
	/opt/redx/lua/src/bin/main.lua:136: in function 'handler'
	/usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/application.lua:405: in function 'handler'
	/usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/application.lua:416: in function </usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/application.lua:412>
	[C]: in function 'xpcall'
	/usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/application.lua:412: in function 'dispatch'
	/usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/nginx.lua:181: in function 'serve'
	access_by_lua(redx.conf:66):2: in function <access_by_lua(redx.conf:66):1>


I am still pretty green when it comes to R and programming more generally.  Anyone have suggestions on what might be causing this? The app runs perfectly in Rstudio. 

Best,
Jon
